text_block_list.text: "Ligne Droite" is a dance party held at Tracen Academy at the end of March.
Watching the decorated gym and the Umamusume bustling about with their preparations, I was just thinking how that time of year had come around again, when—

Found Seiun Sky taking a nap
in the spectator stands.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Zzz... zzz...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: We've finished hanging the lights on that side! We still need to do the center and near the entrance—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phoo, phoo... *gasp*!
Ahaha, blowing up this many balloons is quite tiring~!

It was bustling all around.
Thinking I should probably wake her up,
I placed a hand on her shoulder and went to shake her gently—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wah!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu.
Were you surprised~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Trainers who wake up sleeping girls get the
"Surprise Sei-chan" punishment.
So with that said, good niiiiight.
choice_data_list: Won't we get in trouble later?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, Trainer.
You don't need to fret,
I've got work I was assigned to do~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah, you doubt me. It's true, really~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
King caught me while I was taking a nap.
She said, 'I've saved a job just for you.'

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It seemed like more of a pain to resist, so she's just sitting here quietly waiting for her turn.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"More importantly... look, look, what do you think?
It's my finest outfit, given to me enthusiastically by my grandpa."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Looks sharp, don't you think?
choice_data_list: I think that outfit is very you.
I think that outfit really suits you.
It's so elegant and lovely, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Looks sharp, don't you think?
choice_data_list: I think that outfit is very you.
I think that outfit really suits you.
It's so elegant and lovely, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...
Hmph, that's a pretty safe answer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"If they're a Trainer,
shouldn't they be more like—"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: So cool~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"It looks so good on ya!
Seeing Sei-chan a wee bit sharper than her
usual fluffy self is mighty wonderful!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Half-pants are cute too~
Feels totally like Sei-chan, you know?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The shoelaces and the ribbon tie match. The ribbon's
a little on the longer side, which makes it super cute~

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wait, this hood! It matches the dress, doesn't it?
Hyah~, it's so gorgeous...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Time out.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Eh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
*ahem* Let's change the mood.
All right, let's air things out~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Spe-chan,
are you stressing over a new dress right now by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
Y-You figured it out?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
They look at super tiny details,
like ribbons and blinker hoods.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... To be honest, yeah~
Everything just caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was planning to buy one this year,
but I was just about to give up and settle on renting after all." any

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Still, I want to find a dress that's just right for me, too, just like Sei-chan did...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's keep at it a bit longer!
Thanks, Sei-chan!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, Spe-chan really is incredible.
Even if it was a lie, she managed to get even you to say something like that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...
All right, let's air the room out.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh? Elegance?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, right?
Sei-chan can pull off a transformation too, you know~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in costume! We're about to start lighting adjustments,
so gather in the dance hall! With your partners, please!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wait, pairs?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I told you this morning.
We're doing safety checks while dancing in pairs!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, what should I do? Even if we need pairs...
it doesn't look like anyone is free.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Ditching on my own here would just
be a pain later on anyway..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...That's right.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Please join me for a song~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "It's fine, it's fine, just step in the direction I pull you and I'll manage somehow~"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's right! What's important is finishing work quickly
so I can go take a nap!

Before I knew it, my right hand was taken, an arm went around my left shoulder—
and a pleasant tune began to play across the dance floor.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Right, left, spin all the way around, and arch backwards~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
There you go, you're getting the hang of it.
Aren't you doing a great job, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? Did you just step on my tail?
Come on, cut it out~. Hehe.

"As I surrendered myself to Seiun Sky's lead like that...
before I knew it, the dance was over."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Alright, good work, everyone~

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
U-Um!
What was that step called just now?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It was faithful to the basics, yet somehow so original...!
The two of you were in perfect sync—it was wonderful!
We want to try doing it too!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well now, let's see, hmm...
..."Sei-chan Special"?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Knowing you,
you were probably just giving half-hearted instructions.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
R-Randomly?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
We just have to pretend to be clouds together,
all fluffy and floaty, you know?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The only ones who could dance with that are you...
and that person over there, who can give themselves over to it.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, would you look at that.
We got praised, Trainer.
